name: web-sunny-blue-cold-coffee-site-with-floating-cups-and-pastel-flavour-cards
title: Cold-brew coffee site with a sky-blue cloud hero and floating cups, pastel flavour cards with cans, a story section and giant 'machi' footer
whatItIs: Two page columns over a sky-cloud backdrop: a hero with floating iced coffees and 'Bold coffee. Better moments.' with a black button, a 'fan favorites' section with rounded pastel cards (peach, mint, yellow, pink) holding cans and white buttons; a story block with an iced latte splash photo and stats, a table photo with two iced drinks and a giant black lowercase 'machi' footer wordmark.
whatItMeans: Fresh and sunny; sky and pastel cards make cold coffee feel bright.
techniques: Float products in a sky hero.
Tint each flavour card in its own pastel.
Use a giant lowercase footer wordmark.
Pair sky photos with warm table photos.

vocabulary.definition: Products suspended in a sky scene.
A tinted card for one variant.
A huge brand name at the page end.
A photo of sky and clouds.
